name: tow
description: Tag Ontology for Wiki: skills for a tag-first LLM wiki in Obsidian (PARA, classification fields, concept tag ontology).

interface.longDescription: Search and check local Obsidian notes by categories and concept tags. Suggest tags and reconcile the tag dictionary after you approve the selected changes. Requires a local vault, Python 3.10+ and Node.js 22.18+; runs the tag-ontology CLI from npm. Your agent host processes the note content you open and controls file permissions. TOW has no hosted backend.
defaultPrompt: Find my project notes about RAG.
Check these notes against the TOW conventions.
Suggest concept tags for this note.
